simple.summary: נָתַח (nâthach) means to dismember First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 18 23.

definitions.usage: cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces.
definitions.full: H5408. nathach [ נָתַח verb only Pi`el cut up, cut in pieces, divide by joints (Dr 1811, 7 ; Late Hebrew id. , Pi`el; rare); — Pi`el Perfect נִתַּח Lev 8:20 , וְנִתַּח consecutive 1:6 , 12 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְנַתַּח 1Kin 18:33 , suffix וַיְנַתְּחֵ֫הוּ 1Sam 11:7 , וַיְנַתְּחֶ֫הָ Judg 19:29 , etc.; — cut up, in pieces , with accusative of animals 1Sam 11:7 , of woman Judg 20:6 (all these to be sent about as token for assembling warriors; on significance of the practice compare RS Sem i. 383; 2nd ed. 402 ); elsewhere usually + לִנְתָחִים , cut up into pieces , of woman 19:29 ; of sacrificial animals 1Kin 18:23 , 33 (accusative only), Exod 29:17 ; Lev 1:6 , 12 ; 8:20 (all P).
